newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks seen opening higher, data due.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks seen opening higher, data due.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were seen opening stronger on Friday morning, with spill-over momentum from the furious buying late yesterday fueling the Dow.
Yesterday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average roared back from whopping losses after late computer buying programs helped the index close nearly unchanged.
"We should open on a firm note, carrying forward the momentum from yesterday," said Larry Wachtel, market analyst for Prudential Securities.
